project.name: Book
project.identity: A browser-based interactive reading and authoring product that presents chapter fragments as cinematic, chapter-specific reading experiences and supports a private Author Studio for content operations.
project.audience: Readers who want an immersive literary experience and the single author or maintainer who imports, edits, previews, publishes, and rolls back chapters.
project.core_loop: Load a chapter manifest, render its text and presentation layers, and use the bounded Author Studio path to import, edit, preview, publish, or roll back content when the production prerequisites are available.
project.north_star: Every published chapter makes the story easier to enter and the authoring path safer to operate, with presentation serving the narrative rather than obscuring it.
not_this: A video-background or effects-first showcase disconnected from the story
Proof of hosted production behavior from local source or documentation alone
A self-service public admin or reader-account platform

mvp.definition: A local reader can load the manifest, navigate authored chapters, and apply the documented chapter-specific text, theme, motion, and audio behavior through the existing validation path.

complete_product.definition: The deployed Node/Postgres product supports the reader and single-author Author Studio loop with safe import, normalized editing, preview, audio-cue validation, publish readiness, version history, rollback, and recorded production acceptance.

outcomes.name: Readers can load and navigate authored chapters from the manifest without losing the intended reading flow.
